# The problem {.section-teal}

Agentic AI moves faster than anyone can read

## Why build this?

[Goal]{.kicker}

[Every other day, a short, verified digest of what changed in agentic AI lands in our team's Signal group, with no one having to search for it.]{.lead}

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.cardbox .teal}
**What it covers** LLM releases for agents, agent frameworks and SDKs, the MCP / tool ecosystem, and open-source agent tooling.
:::
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.cardbox}
**What it must not do** Invent facts, cite pages it never read, repeat old news, or overspend.
:::
:::
::::

- **Dashed arrows are conditional** routes: the graph decides at run time
- `select` ends the run when there's nothing new, so no empty messages are sent
- 7 nodes · 11 edges (7 conditional, 4 fixed), printed straight from the code with `python -m digest graph`

## Not a sequential chain {.smaller}

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.cardbox .teal}
**Planner decomposes the query** into 4 research topics, with starting URLs checked for being real.
:::

::: {.cardbox .purple}
**Parallel branches.** LangGraph `Send` runs 4 research agents at the same time.
:::

::: {.cardbox .navy}
**Fact-check retry loop** sends an empty topic back to its agent once, with feedback, unless 3+ items are already verified.
:::
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.cardbox}
**Quality loop.** The critic sends the draft back to the writer (at most 2 revisions).
:::

::: {.cardbox .teal}
**Conditional routing.** No new verified news means END: no empty messages.
:::

::: {.cardbox .purple}
**Checkpoints** after every step, so a crashed run resumes where it stopped.
:::
:::
::::

## Inside a research agent

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="45%"}
```{mermaid}
%%| fig-width: 4
flowchart TB
  M{{"model<br/>decides next step"}} -- "tool call" --> T[tools]
  T -- result --> M
  M -- "no tool call<br/>= done" --> O([findings])
  G[guard rails] -.-> M
```
:::
::: {.column width="55%"}
Built with LangChain **`create_agent`**: the model picks a tool, reads the result, and **stops when it answers without a tool call**.

| Tool | Job |
|---|---|
| `web_search` | Anthropic search via Claude Haiku |
| `fetch_page` | Free page reading |
| `check_already_sent` | Memory of past digests |
| `save_finding` | Saves only verified items |
:::
::::

# Reliability {.section-coral}

The agents can't publish what they didn't verify

## Guard rails in the tools

::: {.steps}
1. **Seen URLs only.** `fetch_page` opens only URLs from the starting list, search results, or links on pages already read. No guessing from memory.
2. **Exact quotes.** `save_finding` rejects an item unless its `evidence_quote` appears on a page the agent actually fetched.
3. **Real dates.** The publication date must be shown on that page and fall inside the window.
4. **Fact-check against the source.** A second model compares each summary with the page excerpt and rejects unsupported claims.
:::

## Guard rails in action

| The agent tries to… | The tool answers |
|---|---|
| save a finding from a page it **never read** | [Rejected: you haven't fetched that page]{.accent} |
| save an **invented quote** | [Rejected: the quote must be copied exactly from the page]{.accent} |
| claim a **date that isn't on the page** | [Rejected: that date doesn't appear on the page]{.accent} |
| open a URL **guessed from memory** | [Not allowed: use web_search to find it first]{.accent} |
| repeat the **same search** twice | [Loop detected; repeats stop the agent]{.accent} |
| save a **real, verified** finding | Saved ✅ |

## Limits, fallbacks, budget

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="33%"}
::: {.stat}
[20]{.num}
[model turns per agent (12 on retry)]{.label}
:::
:::
::: {.column width="33%"}
::: {.stat}
[5]{.num}
[searches per agent (3 on retry)]{.label}
:::
:::
::: {.column width="33%"}
::: {.stat}
[$1]{.num}
[hard budget per run]{.label}
:::
:::
::::

- `ModelCallLimitMiddleware`, `ToolCallLimitMiddleware`, and our own **`LoopDetector`** and **`TimeLimit`** (4 min per agent, 2 on retry)
- `ModelFallbackMiddleware`: free model → second free model → Claude Haiku
- If search is down (outage, no credits), agents keep going with free page reading; the writer falls back to a free model

## Crash recovery, for real

::: {.callout-warning}
## Mid-run, the API credits ran out
`Your credit balance is too low to access the Anthropic API`. One agent had finished; three crashed.
:::

::: {.steps}
1. The run was marked **failed**, and its LangGraph checkpoint was kept
2. After credits were added, the next run printed `resuming unfinished run … from its last checkpoint`
3. The planner and the finished agent were **not** run again, so their cost wasn't paid twice
4. The crash also led to a fix: search failures now degrade gracefully instead of crashing the agent
:::

# Live demo {.section-sunset}

## Four commands

::: {.steps}
1. `python -m digest graph`: the architecture, printed from the code
2. `python -m digest guardrails`: the guard rails catching a careless agent (free)
3. `python -m pytest -q`: **28 offline tests** (guard rails, routing, retry loop, memory, cost, time limits)
4. `python -m digest run --dry-run`: a real run on today's news, step by step
:::

[Add `--force` instead of `--dry-run` to post the digest to Signal.]{.muted}

# Lessons learned {.section-teal}

## Real runs found real bugs

| What we saw | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| 14 pages "could not be read" | The planner invented article URLs from memory | Planner gives index pages only; dead URLs are dropped before agents start |
| Old news ("Claude 4 release") | Agents could claim any date | The date must appear on the fetched page |
| All 4 findings rejected | Summary checked against **one** quoted sentence | Fact-check against a page excerpt |
| Window shrank to 1 day | An empty run counted as "sent" | Empty runs are recorded separately |

::: {.callout-tip}
The test suite grew from 22 to 28 as these fixes landed: date checks, empty runs, outages, the editor and time limits.
:::

## Takeaways {.dark}

- **Agents decide; code verifies.** The model chooses tools freely, but nothing reaches the group unless it's on a page the agent really read
- [Graphs beat chains]{.accent}: parallel agents, a fact-check retry loop and a quality loop, each with a clear exit
- **Spend money only where it matters**: free models for reasoning, Claude for search and writing, and a hard budget per run
- **Test with real runs.** Every major bug was found by running the system for real
